mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger central bank stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate synchronized consumer demand recovery, which precedes corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In early recovery phases, a rebound in industrial production (INDPRO) from below 95.0 signals resolution of supply constraints, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rebounds from below 95.0 in early recovery, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior three months indicates strengthening consumer confidence, correlating with rising corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST shows sustained upward trend, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation requiring monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate robust labor market recovery, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through stronger consumer spending.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE declines simultaneously, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.0%), a monthly decline in unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines in high-unemployment regime, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
